_comment: Declared layering for the grown checkout fixture (playground/_states/07-checkout-cycle-grown). 'order' is high-to-low. With 'order' and 'layer_of' present the gate runs a free deterministic up-dependency check and needs no API key; 'responsibilities' additionally enables the semantic check, constrained to these rules and never open-ended review. This spec exists so the ten-module tree can be read as two regions with different bars: a cross-team seam where the contract is enforced, and cells where it is not.
rules: R1: a module may depend only on modules in a lower layer, so the shared layer never reaches back up
R2: only the entry layer may perform I/O
R3: a shared module holds one concept and no orchestration

responsibilities.pricing: the canonical minor-unit conversion and the discount arithmetic behind it
responsibilities.audit_log: append an immutable record of a decision
